lessons.title: Practice Modern C STL Algorithms
lessons.description: Modern C++ checkpoint: implement sortVector(std::vector<int>& vec) so it sorts the vector in place with std::sort over the [vec.begin(), vec.end()) iterator range. The test sorts {3, 1, 2} and checks the result.
